text:
Clara: Sparrow renewal came in but PO SP-2026-301 shows 'annual' term at a different rate than our signed quote. Also it lists a third-party payer. Can we confirm?
Ben: I compared the PO to Quote-Q-301. Price mismatch: PO lower by 8%. Procurement note says discount approved by procurement lead. Need sales confirmation.
Tess: Onboarding at 92% 0% feature rollout planned tomorrow. If pricing or signer changes, we may have to pause. CSM: please prep brief customer note.
FinanceBot: FIN-5033 opened: missing GL code and third-party payer needs payor-letter + VAT ID. Cannot process invoices until resolved.
LegalBot: If third-party payer is paying, we need a signed payor letter or addendum. Also pricing changes must be reflected in an amendment signed by both parties. I can draft both templates.
Clara: Action: Ben, get confirmation from sales on the approved discount and authorized approver name. Tess, hold the release if docs not cleared by EOD. FinanceBot, await payor docs.
Ben: Sales confirms a one-time procurement discount but says it requires Sales Director sign-off. I'll secure an approval email and update contract amendment.
FinanceBot: Received procurement email promising payor-letter by COB. FIN-5033 updated.
LegalBot: Drafted amendment and payor-letter templates and uploaded to /docs/amendments/SP_301_payor_and_discount_v1.docx. Will route for countersign once Sales provides approval.
Clara: Looping back: Sales approval arrived by email, payor-letter uploaded. Legal 0? can you confirm amendment matches PO and we can proceed to signature?
LegalBot: Reviewed. Amendment matches approved discount and payor. Recommend e-sign via DocuSign; if customer's portal blocks links accept scanned signed amendment + payor-letter.
Tess: Onboarding hold lifted after Legal confirmed. Release scheduled tomorrow as planned. Closing thread.
